rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for a class period or lesson at school.

example.english: In today's English lesson, the teacher taught passive voice.
example.traditional: 今日英文堂老師教被動語態。
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 jing1 man4 tong4 lou5 si1 gaau1 bei6 dung6 jyu5 taai3

rows.note: Use this for work or an assignment that a teacher gives a student to do, especially at home.

example.english: I still have a lot of lesson assignments to finish tonight.
example.traditional: 我今晚仲有好多功課未做。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 maan5 zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 gung1 fo3 mei6 zou6

rows.note: Use this for a lesson learned from an experience, especially a cautionary or painful one.

example.english: Getting fired that time taught me a painful lesson.
example.traditional: 嗰次炒魷魚畀咗我一個深刻嘅教訓。
example.jyutping: go2 ci3 caau2 jau4 jyu4 bei2 zo2 ngo5 jat1 go3 sam1 hak1 ge3 gaau3 fan3
